speaker: Sandsea Moogle
line_text: Did you see that Urutan-Yensa just now, kupo? They're usually a violent lot...but this one wanted help. Interested? (choices: Tell me. / I couldn't care less.) / The Urutan-Yensa are all up in a panic about a creature on the Nam-Yensa Sandsea...their blood enemy, it seems! One of them was asking for help...an Urutan- Yensa asking for help! Whatever it is, it's got to be bad, kupo. You look pretty strong...maybe you could have a swing at the thing, kupo? It's supposed to be something like a giant tortoise... He said he'd found some treasure of the sandsea, too. Why, you might be able to claim that as a reward if you're successful, kupo. / Well, that's fine. To each his own! So...what brings you out here? You don't look like your average travelers... Hmm, suspicious, kupo! / If you defeat this beast, you could claim the treasure of the sandsea! Look for the tortoise, kupo! / You killed the wild scourge of the sandsea, kupo!? Amaaaaazing! By the way, that Urutan-Yensa from before...he just went by, kupo. Maybe he was going to look for that "treasure" for you? Unusually kind of him! He was headed for the Ogir-Yensa Sandsea... / That Urutan-Yensa from before was just through here, kupo. Maybe he was going to look for that "treasure" for you? Unusually kind of him! He was headed for the Ogir-Yensa Sandsea... / That rogue Urutan...he wouldn't have been happy back with his clan, I'm sure of it, kupo. / That flower... It's rare to see one blooming in the sandsea, kupo. Maybe the treasure that he found...was this? / It's rare to see a flower blooming in the sandsea, kupo. And not just any flower! There's a particularly dangerous avion known as the "garuda" that's said to be quite unfond of this flower's scent, kupo... A treasure indeed!

speaker: Wayward Chocobo
line_text: Kweh! Kweh! (This chocobo seems to have been separated from its friends. It looks lonely.) Ride the chocobo? (choices: Giddyap! / No, thanks.) / Kweh! Kweh! (The chocobo looks a mite peckish. Feed it some gysahl greens and it may let you ride it.) Feed the chocobo gysahl greens? (choices: Yes / No) / Kweh! Kweh! (The chocobo looks a mite peckish. Feed it some gysahl greens and it may let you ride it.) Kweh!? Kwehhh! (The chocobo doesn't smell any greens on you and clearly wants to be left alone.) / K-Kweh!? Kwehhh! (The chocobo trembles in fear at the sight of the Esper.) Kweh—kweh, kweh... (The chocobo looks like it would let you ride if you dismissed the Esper first.) / K—kweh!? Kwehhh! (The chocobo trembles in fear at the sight of the Esper.) Kweh—kweh, kweh... (The chocobo clearly wants you to dismiss the Esper and give it some gysahl greens.)

speaker: Dyce; Dilah
line_text: You still wandering these reaches? Time to give up treasure hunting, I'd say. The shining bird'll peck at your bones, boy... / Lo there, adventurer! If you're truly set on going to the Valley of the Dead, I'll give you some advice. The avion there is said to be invincible, but it has a weakness. I'm sure the Urutan-Yensa know something...this sandsea is theirs, you see. / You can't just go giving people fool advice like that! What if they actually went out and tried to do it!? That'd be blood on your hands. That said, if anyone knows the way through the Valley of the Dead, it's the Urutan-Yensa. But how to ask...? They don't speak our tongue. By the by, you need anything? Take a look at my wares! You might just be surprised at what you find... / You still gallivanting about— Eh? You've claimed a treasure of the Urutan-Yensa!? / Well, adventurer, there may be more to you than I thought. With that, you may just be able to defeat the avion. / Say, if you do find some treasure in the Valley of the Dead, send some this way, eh? Ha ha ha! Now, care to buy anything? / Oh? Unusual to see people out here... We're trying to catch us some sandfish, but they're not biting. / Why have you come to such a place? You seem to be adventurers, yes... Surely, you did not come to hunt treasure in the Valley of the Dead! / The Valley of the Dead? Treasure hunter or no, you'd best avoid that place. 'Less you care to tangle with an avion most dire... What I want to know is, are you outfitted for the desert? I'm something of a merchant...if there's anything you need, let me know!

speaker: Balthier; Monid
line_text: Balthier I dare say Ba'Gamnan could have done with a good sand scrub some time ago. / Monid He was the hunter stalker. He'd been tryin' to lure you out all this time. Can't say as why, though. / Monid Why the long faces? The plan worked, didn't it? / Monid Ah, Montblanc didn't tell you, did he. Well, if you haven't put two and two together yet, the Belito hunt was all for show, a way to lure the hunter stalker into the open. / Monid Montblanc knew we couldn't let him go unchecked, so after we hunted the Trickster down he asked me to look into this stalker business. None of my investigations were leading anywhere, and the longer we waited, the more victims kept piling up. So Montblanc and I talked it over and decided to use this Belito hunt as a trap to lure him out. Figured a hunt somewhere nice and isolated ought to do the trick. And I went ahead to lie in wait. / Monid And it worked. Probably had somethin' to do with you. There's somethin' about you folks... Either way, it worked. / Monid Oh, and a phony hunt means no bounty, obviously. So don't go expectin' one. / Monid Hah! I'm only pullin' your tail! Tough crowd... / Monid Ahem...anyway, don't worry. Montblanc gave me your bounty. Should probably be him to give it to you, but I guess it's all the same. Probably best to do it out here, actually. Phony hunts and lures...can't blame the boss for wanting to keep that quiet. Here ya go. I'll be headin' back to the Hall. Good hunting.

line_text: Sandsea Moogle Kupo! A gathering of the Urutan-Yensa! / Sandsea Moogle A truly rare occurrence, kupo! / Sandsea Moogle ...Kupo? Kupo-po!? / Sandsea Moogle Wait, what's happening, kupo!? / Sandsea Moogle Wait! No! They're going to execute him! / Sandsea Moogle Don't do this! The creature would still be at large if it weren't for his plea for help, kupo! / Queen of the Urutan You shame us by seeking aid outside the tribe! Urutan-Yensa are lords and masters of the great sea! We seek the aid of none! / Queen of the Urutan Your words are the howling of the sand to my ears! I condemn you to dust! / Sandsea Moogle (gasp) / Sandsea Moogle Wh-Wh-What have you done, kupo!? / Sandsea Moogle You bring him back! / Queen of the Urutan Those who sully our name will be punished, be they foeman or kin. They must pay the honor-price. There can be no forgiveness! I would destroy you, too...but I am merciful. Better you live to tell the world that the Urutan are not to be taken lightly. Now, leave!
So we've drawn you out at last! / The moth cannot resist the flame. Now you will burn!
I've been biding my time trolling for hunters. So long you've kept me waiting! / I was beginning to think you didn't care!
You are looking rather careworn. / Are the lizards in the sandpits not company enough for you? / (empty string)
My blade requires a sharper tongue to keep its edge!
